title: The prompt asks the agent to audit and fix the file thoroughly, but the golden file fixes only two calculation errors (the DIO average window and the Senior Notes interest average); every compared cell must match, so an agent that correctly fixes other genuine errors in the graded ranges will fail.
evidence: Golden still has: 'Income Statement'!J26 = -'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73, which is the 2022 interest booked in 2021, with N26 = -I73 (blank, so 0); 'PP&E, Debt, NWC' rows 81-83 shifted one year (C81='Balance Sheet'!C17 under 2015, while C80='Balance Sheet'!D15); 'Line Item Metrics'!H24 averages H27:J27; H35 = 'Balance Sheet'!J22/H12. Fixing any of these changes values in DCF, LBO, Returns or Line Item Metrics by more than 1%.
